subject.title: fix(agent): duplicate same-session turn when the gateway connection drops after accepting a run

question: Should this PR land as the narrow same-session collision fix, or should it pause until the accepted-disconnect path is redesigned around reattach-first recovery?
rationale: The code fix is narrow and supported, but it intentionally preserves a second-run fallback after gateway acceptance, which is a user-visible delivery and side-effect tradeoff now tracked by the related issue.

options.title: Land narrow fix now
options.body: Accept the fresh fallback session as the immediate bug fix and leave reattach-first/no-recook behavior to the related issue.

options.title: Fold into reattach-first
options.body: Ask the contributor to extend this branch into the broader reattach-first recovery so accepted disconnects avoid a second run when possible.

options.title: Keep recook behavior unchanged
options.body: Close or pause the PR if maintainers prefer not to change fallback session ownership for accepted disconnects before deciding the broader policy.

recommendation.title: Land narrow fix now
recommendation.body: Accept the fresh fallback session as the immediate bug fix and leave reattach-first/no-recook behavior to the related issue.

likelyOwner.reason: The most relevant recent command-path history is the explicit-recipient-session work on the same module, and that merge-result interaction is central to this PR.
